skills.name: SQLMap request boundaries: Prepare JSON request headers
skills.description: Represent an approved JSON body through supported app fields.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Compare the request with fields the app supports: URL, parameter, method, data, cookie, and headers.
2. Use only structured fields that faithfully represent the approved request.
3. Put body in `data`, set expected method, and add one `Content-Type: application/json` line in `headers`.
4. If a required feature is unsupported, document the gap and stop instead of bypassing app controls.

Safety: test only owner-authorized scope with web.sqlmap and uthorized_target=true. Keep defaults; do not dump records, use shells/server-file access, evade controls, or perform destructive actions.
